name: data-grid-server
title: Data Grid Server
author: gridcn
description: One server data source for the gridcn data grid: useDataGridServerRows owns sort, filter, search, page and page size, fetches one page per state with a race guard, goes back to page 1 on a spec change, keeps the last good rows on screen, and exposes error, retry and refresh. Returns gridProps for DataGrid and pager controls for the pagination bar.
